description: NaCaTiTaO₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.76 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.75 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-29°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.04 Å. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-29°. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.04 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Ti, and one Ta atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, one Ti, and one Ta atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, one Ti, and one Ta atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, one Ti, and one Ta atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, one Ti, and one Ta atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Ti, and one Ta atom.
